entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
----------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Ajit Kumar Dubey, Advocate For the State : Mr. Azeemuddin, APP -----------
th 9/Dated: 20 April, 2023
Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to implead the informant as O.P. No.2 in this case.

Issue notice upon the newly added O.P. No.2 by registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks from today, failing which this revision application shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.
Put up this case on 14.06.2023.

In the meantime, let a report be also called for from the learned Secretary, DLSA, Palamau at Daltonganj as to whether the family member of the informant or deceased have filed any case for grant of compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act or not?
(Sanjay Prasad, J.) Saket/-
